🔥 बॉलीवुड के हैंडसम हंक ऋतिक रोशन ने कर दिया इंटरनेशनल लेवल पर बड़ा कमाल! 😎

लॉस एंजिल्स में 7 नवंबर को आयोजित 15वें LACMA Art + Film Gala में ऋतिक शामिल हुए।

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, वे इस प्रतिष्ठित इवेंट में शिरकत करने वाले पहले मुख्यधारा के भारतीय अभिनेता बन गए हैं।

Gucci द्वारा प्रस्तुत यह एनुअल चैरिटी गाला आर्ट और सिनेमा की दुनिया को सेलिब्रेट करता है।

इस इवेंट में हॉलीवुड स्टार Leonardo DiCaprio और Eva Chow इसे को-चेयर कर रहे थे।

ऋतिक ने इस ब्लैक-टाइ गैदरिंग के लिए इटैलियन फैशन हाउस Brunello Cucinelli का कस्टम टक्सीडो पहना था।

उन्हें इस शानदार इवेंट में इंडियन-ओरिजिन प्रोड्यूसर और वेंचर कैपिटलिस्ट Kavita Gupta ने होस्ट किया था।

इवेंट में Nicole Kidman, Tom Hanks, Timothée Chalamet, Kylie Jenner और Kim Kardashian जैसे बड़े ग्लोबल चेहरे भी मौजूद थे।

क्या आपने ऋतिक का यह इंटरनेशनल लुक देखा? 🤩

ctx.text:
Hrithik Roshan attended the 15th LACMA Art + Film Gala in Los Angeles, joining Leonardo DiCaprio, Nicole Kidman and other international celebrities.
Actor Hrithik Roshan attended the 15th edition of the LACMA Art + Film Gala, held in Los Angeles on November 7. His appearance at the annual event marks a notable moment for Indian representation at the international cultural gathering, with Hrithik reportedly becoming the first mainstream Indian actor to attend the gala.
The event, presented by Gucci, celebrates achievements in art and filmmaking. It is co-chaired by Hollywood actor Leonardo DiCaprio and entrepreneur Eva Chow. This year's edition honoured filmmaker Denis Villeneuve, known for directing Dune , and artist Vija Celmins for their contributions to cinema and the visual arts.
For the occasion, Hrithik opted for a custom tuxedo by Italian luxury fashion house Brunello Cucinelli. The actor kept his look classic, choosing a formal ensemble for the black-tie gathering.
Hrithik was hosted at the event by Kavita Gupta, an Indian-origin producer and venture capitalist who is also a member of the International Emmy Board. Gupta has been involved in promoting Indian talent on international platforms.
The LACMA Art + Film Gala brought together several prominent names from the worlds of entertainment, fashion, art and business. Among those in attendance were Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hanks, Timothée Chalamet, Nicole Kidman, Andrew Garfield, Anya Taylor-Joy, Rufus Sewell, Ashley Park, Jessica Williams and Monica Barbaro.
Entrepreneurs and fashion personalities, including Kylie Jenner and Kim Kardashian, were also present at the gathering.
The annual charity gala brings together filmmakers, artists, actors, entrepreneurs and philanthropists to celebrate the relationship between art and cinema.
